tools.name: upload_quality_file
tools.description: Upload the ACTUAL original UTF-8 flat csv/jsonl file, at most 10 MiB/50,000 records/100 fields. Stored 24h. A profile/summary/URL/server path cannot stand in for a complete file.
tools.prerequisites: Explicit permission to read the source; remote upload also needs permission to transmit it
tools.outputs: Upload identity/fingerprint or bounded inferred schema
tools.retry: Uploads create new identities; reuse the successful upload rather than uploading again

tools.name: draft_quality_contract
tools.description: Save a new unapproved contract version with explicit field types, numeric locale, null decisions and stable rule IDs/actions. Supported: not_null, unique, accepted_values, null_rate, row_count, range. Review before approval.
tools.prerequisites: Owned source plus explicit target rules/decisions
tools.outputs: Unapproved proposal, version or sampled preview; not approval or full validation
tools.approval: Do not infer business meanings; obtain missing decisions
tools.retry: Reads/previews may repeat; saved drafts/versions can create new identities

tools.name: get_quality_contract
tools.description: Read an owned contract's exact decisions and approval hash/version before reuse.
tools.task: Read an owned result or decision
tools.prerequisites: Existing owned resource and current account authorization
tools.outputs: Structured result; inspect disclosed coverage and errors
tools.approval: Read access within the user's task
tools.retry: Read again using the same resource identity

tools.name: list_quality_contracts
tools.description: List owned contract identities in pages of 50; read the full contract before reviewing or approving it.
tools.task: Read an owned result or decision
tools.prerequisites: Existing owned resource and current account authorization
tools.outputs: Structured result; inspect disclosed coverage and errors
tools.approval: Read access within the user's task
tools.retry: Read again using the same resource identity

tools.name: delete_quality_decision
tools.description: Delete an owned contract or baseline after explicit operator instruction. kind is quality_contract or quality_baseline. Pending checks using it fail safely. Does not start a check or consume credits.
tools.prerequisites: Existing owned resource and current account authorization
tools.outputs: Deletion status; dependent pending jobs can fail safely
tools.retry: Read current state before retry; do not delete another version

tools.name: approve_quality_contract
tools.description: Approve this exact contract hash only after operator authorization and review of destination meanings, locale, nulls, actions and disclosed coverage.
tools.prerequisites: Exact reviewed hash/fingerprint and scope, with all unresolved choices settled
tools.outputs: Approval bound to that exact version
tools.approval: Explicit authorized reviewer approval; fixture permission covers only owned fixtures
tools.retry: Reuse only the same reviewed version and scope; edits invalidate approval

tools.name: draft_quality_baseline
tools.description: Draft a versioned row-count baseline from the actual owned reference file for an approved contract declaring a threshold/action. Never replaces a baseline automatically.
tools.prerequisites: Owned source plus explicit target rules/decisions
tools.outputs: Unapproved proposal, version or sampled preview; not approval or full validation
tools.approval: Do not infer business meanings; obtain missing decisions
tools.retry: Reads/previews may repeat; saved drafts/versions can create new identities

tools.name: approve_quality_baseline
tools.description: Approve the reviewed exact baseline hash for its specific contract after operator authorization.
tools.prerequisites: Exact reviewed hash/fingerprint and scope, with all unresolved choices settled
tools.outputs: Approval bound to that exact version
tools.approval: Explicit authorized reviewer approval; fixture permission covers only owned fixtures
tools.retry: Reuse only the same reviewed version and scope; edits invalidate approval

tools.name: get_quality_baseline
tools.description: Read owned baseline reference-file fingerprint, row count and approval/version.
tools.task: Read an owned result or decision
tools.prerequisites: Existing owned resource and current account authorization
tools.outputs: Structured result; inspect disclosed coverage and errors
tools.approval: Read access within the user's task
tools.retry: Read again using the same resource identity

tools.name: quote_quality_check
tools.description: Quote one entire-file check with exact approved versions and original SHA256, expiring in 10 minutes. Completed continue, block and continue_with_warnings outcomes each cost one quality credit ($20/100); errors/platform failures are free. Quoting consumes no credit and does not start work.
tools.prerequisites: Owned upload, approved matching contract and any approved baseline
tools.outputs: Quote, expiry, exact fingerprints and funding
tools.approval: Approval required before quoting; quote does not start work
tools.retry: Reuse the original quote/key for an uncertain started request; only quote anew for genuinely new work

tools.name: start_quality_check
tools.description: Authorize a quoted full-file preflight and reserve one QUALITY credit under the quality cap. Reuse this quote/key on retries. Completed continue/warning/block consumes one; errors release it. Feed credits cannot fund this.
tools.prerequisites: Unexpired funded quote and stable idempotency key
tools.credits: Reserves one check; completed continue, block or continue_with_warnings outcomes consume one; platform failures release the reservation
tools.retry: Original quote AND original key; changed requests need a new quote/key; never start twice after a timeout

tools.name: get_quality_check
tools.description: Read an owned job and operational receipt; does not start another check. Downstream writes proceed only on continue by default.
tools.task: Read an owned result or decision
tools.prerequisites: Existing owned resource and current account authorization
tools.outputs: Structured result; inspect disclosed coverage and errors
tools.approval: Read access within the user's task
tools.retry: Read again using the same resource identity

tools.name: get_quality_report
tools.description: Read the completed full-file report for seven days: record count, rules, redacted failure counts and bounded record references. This report is NOT the original dataset.
tools.task: Read an owned result or decision
tools.prerequisites: Existing owned resource and current account authorization
tools.outputs: Structured result; inspect disclosed coverage and errors
tools.approval: Read access within the user's task
tools.retry: Read again using the same resource identity

tools.name: get_checked_original_download
tools.description: Get the authenticated original-data download path after continue, while the 24h source retention remains. SHA256 identifies the actual checked bytes; never forward report JSON as customer data.
tools.prerequisites: Owned continue job and original still within 24-hour retention
tools.outputs: Authenticated download path and original SHA256; verify downloaded bytes
tools.approval: Only continue permits downstream writes by default; separate destination authorization
tools.retry: Read again using the same resource identity
